prompt:
Consider the following company information, reported as of 2025-10-30. Act as a credit rating analyst.
| Current ratio           | 1.27 |
| Retained earnings       | 17,093M |
| Current liabilities     | 28,136M |
| Current assets          | 35,630M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 18,552M |
| Total liabilities       | 78,289M |
| Total assets            | 96,889M |
| EBIT / operating income | 3,639M |
| Revenue                 | 12,222M |
Based only on the above and knowledge predating 2025-10-30, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify). Choose exactly one label from: AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company exhibits a healthy current ratio of 1.27 and positive retained earnings, suggesting good short-term liquidity and profitability. However, the total liabilities of 78,289M significantly outweigh the total equity of 18,552M, leading to a high debt-to-equity ratio, indicating substantial financial leverage. Despite decent operating income and revenue, the high debt level presents a considerable long-term risk.

DECISION: BBB-
